openingSummary.zh: 过去约两日的新主线是「Codex/ChatGPT 用量档位澄清」与「Agent 编码栈对比仍在升温」：@thsottiaux（Tibo）连续发帖说明所有 Pro 档均无 5 小时限额、相对 Plus 约 10×/20×/50× 用量（Pro 500 含 ultrafast），并称 Pro 与 Business 100 用量已翻倍，同时明确 GPT 6.1 Terra 不宜对标 Claude Opus 5.5——主战场仍在更高阶模型；社区还热议是否加「Pro 50」。周末 Karpathy 用 Claude Code 三分钟 one-shot 做出 TristanTube（约 4.7 万条硬核视频+TV 模式）的叙事仍在延续。研究侧 alphaXiv 热榜出现短上下文 Agent（《You don't need long context》）、潜空间 swarm（SwarmEvolve）与 Agentic RL targeted guidance；工程博客上 DeepMind 有 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 与 Antigravity 化学信息学 Agent 技能。缺口：@OpenAI / @AnthropicAI / @claudeai / @GoogleAI / @GoogleDeepMind / @AIatMeta / @Meta / @AndrewYNg 近 48h 无高信号原创；关注列表仍无 DeepSeek 一手 X。
openingSummary.en: Over ~48h the new leads are Codex/ChatGPT usage-tier clarifications and a still-hot agent coding-stack matchup: @thsottiaux (Tibo) said all Pro plans have no 5-hour limits, map to ~10×/20×/50× vs Plus (Pro 500 unlocks ultrafast), claimed Pro and Business 100 usage were doubled, and stressed GPT 6.1 Terra is not meant to duel Claude Opus 5.5—OpenAI’s big-league models sit elsewhere; he also floated a “Pro 50” tier. Karpathy’s weekend Claude Code three-minute TristanTube one-shot (~47K nerdy videos + TV mode) still echoes. On the research side, alphaXiv highlights short-context agents (*You don't need long context*), latent swarm evolution (SwarmEvolve), and Agentic RL targeted guidance; DeepMind’s eng surface shows Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash and Antigravity cheminformatics skills. Gaps: @OpenAI / @AnthropicAI / @claudeai / @GoogleAI / @GoogleDeepMind / @AIatMeta / @Meta / @AndrewYNg quiet on high-signal originals; still no DeepSeek primary X on the watchlist.

summary.en: Tibo clarifies: all Pro plans have no 5-hour limits; vs Plus, Pro 100/200/500 are ~10×/20×/50× usage, with Pro 500 unlocking ultrafast—answering ChatGPT/Codex quota chatter head-on.

summary.zh: Tibo：把 GPT 6.1 Terra 拿去对标 Claude Opus 5.5 很离谱——Terra 不错但不在「大联盟」竞争位，OpenAI 另有主战模型。
summary.en: Tibo: lining GPT 6.1 Terra up against Claude Opus 5.5 is wild—Terra is strong but not the big-league matchup; OpenAI has other models for that.

summary.zh: Tibo 追问社区要不要再加一档「Pro 50」；同日早些时候还称 Pro 与 Business 100 用量已翻倍，互动极高。

alphaxivTop3.title: You don't need long context
alphaxivTop3.authors: Peter Belcak, Saurav Muralidharan, Pavlo Molchanov et al. (NVIDIA)

summary.zh: （Agent/Claude/GPT 优先）用会话压缩与选择性读文档，让 Agent 在短上下文下接近全历史基线；文中以 Claude Opus 4.5 / GPT 5.6 Sol 等在 SWE-bench 等上的 SAC 表现论证「不必堆超长上下文」，并提出可解释自然语言状态的 SSSM 方向。
summary.en: (Agent/Claude/GPT pick) Compaction + selective reading keeps short-context agents near full-history baselines; argues Claude Opus 4.5 / GPT 5.6 Sol hold up under SAC on SWE/Terminal-style benches—and sketches SSSMs with natural-language state.

alphaxivTop3.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization

summary.zh: （Agent 优先）数百小 LLM Agent 在潜空间推理、经 KV cache 通信，无需长文本 CoT；作者称单卡可在数分钟内做数学/科学程序演化搜索，强调速度与多样性。
summary.en: (Agent pick) Hundreds of small LLM agents reason in latent space and communicate via KV-cache transfer (no long text CoT); authors report evolutionary math/science program search in minutes on one GPU, stressing speed and diversity.

alphaxivTop3.title: Stabilizing On-Policy Targeted Guidance in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
alphaxivTop3.authors: Kevin Frans, Alexander M Rush, Sergey Levine

summary.zh: （Agentic RL / Coding Agent）用按轮文本反馈的 on-policy self-distillation（targeted guidance）教编码 Agent 新工具与风格行为，同时稳住熵、避免拖垮基线 RL 表现。
summary.en: (Agentic RL / coding-agent pick) Per-turn textual feedback via on-policy self-distillation (targeted guidance) teaches new tools/styles without collapsing baseline RL—focus on stable entropy through training.
